label: B25-COMPOSITE-IDENTITY-BOARD-CLOSEOUT
title: Run one fail-closed candidate interaction under the adopted composite live identity contract
triggered_by: T-031 stopped before terminal on an unobservable candidate design-hash gate; T-032 adopted exact programmer evidence plus candidate-unique pre-input startup as a fail-closed live identity contract.

authorization.user_statement: 许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备；直接使用给定nios2-terminal命令读取和交互。
authorization.scope: Exactly one volatile candidate configuration, one live terminal session and exactly one volatile golden restoration.

reads: T-021/T-031 task-local runner artifacts as templates only
exact T-030 candidate SOF and exact golden SOF read-only
scope: In one uninterrupted gamepc ownership window, prove initial golden state, execute one exact candidate programmer transaction, use the first live terminal's candidate-unique startup as the live identity gate, run the paced command and RX observability acceptance, then always execute one exact golden restoration. No internal retry is allowed.

acceptance.preflight: Remote root absent; candidate/golden hashes exact; no conflicting EDA/programmer/terminal or port-1310 owner; exactly one preserved standard jtagserver; initial read-only chain is exact golden with JTAG UART/PHY.
acceptance.script_seal: Before any hardware action, syntax-check/hash the exact local and uploaded remote scripts and record a manifest. Scripts are immutable after sealing.
acceptance.single_use_guards: Create task-owned durable candidate/golden invocation markers immediately before each quartus_pgm call. Candidate marker must be absent then written once; golden marker likewise. Any pre-existing marker or attempted second call fails without invoking programmer. Final counts must be candidate=1 and golden=1.
acceptance.candidate_program: One task-owned 15 MHz/channel-0 server and one exact quartus_pgm candidate transaction. Require exact path/checksum/JTAG-ID, exit 0, configuration/operation success and 0 errors/0 warnings; stop only the owned server. Programmer PASS is not live identity or functional PASS.
acceptance.live_identity: Immediately start the first and only live direct terminal. Before sending any byte require, in order, LCVEX25 BOOT, CAL-(OK|WAIT|FAIL), DDR-(OK|FAIL), READY, RXDBG 00000000 00000000 and a later nonzero-read/zero-event RXDBG TX-drain page. If absent, send zero bytes and proceed directly to golden restoration. Cached standard-server design hash is diagnostic only.
acceptance.paced_commands: In the same session send raw bytes strictly in order and only after the preceding response: ? -> CLOCK25 CAL-* DDR-*; p -> PONG; d -> a new immediate RXDBG whose event count/last byte reflect d; Z -> an echo observed after the Z send offset. Stop at first missing response.
acceptance.observability: Require final RXDBG event count=4/last byte=0x5A; RXPATH bridge=PoC=dmem with low16=0xA45A, each valid count at least four and fault bits zero; RXCPU getc/dispatch count=4, getc low16=0xA45A, dispatch class=5/byte=0x5A and positive putc/TX progress.
acceptance.golden_restore: On success or any failure, stop only the task-owned terminal and execute exactly one golden quartus_pgm transaction with a fresh owned server. Require golden programmer/checksum/JTAG-ID success, final golden design hash and UART/PHY nodes, preserved standard server, zero residual task processes and free port 1310. Final board state must be golden.
acceptance.overall: Only the full candidate startup + paced commands + RXDBG/RXPATH/RXCPU predicates and successful golden restoration constitute PASS. Programmer/startup-only evidence is insufficient.

failure_policy: No internal debug retry. Any setup, candidate, terminal, parser or golden failure terminates this task after the single allowed golden attempt. Preserve artifacts and report; do not rebuild root, upload a replacement script, reprogram candidate, reset, power-cycle or stop global processes.
resource: Hold resource-lock gamepc across preflight, both single-use programming phases, terminal, fetch and postflight. One external ownership window only; no other GamePC task overlaps. Event-driven external waits up to one hour.
forbidden_regions: more than one candidate programmer invocation, more than one golden programmer invocation, terminal reconnect or internal retry
using cached standard-server candidate design hash as an acceptance gate or identity proof
ordinary-file stdin, batching ?/p/d/Z or sending any byte before startup identity/TX-drain gates
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power cycle, standard-jtagserver stop or unknown/pre-existing process stop

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.blocker: Windows command layer split the inline PowerShell parser pipeline before preflight
result.parser_invocations: five distinct ps1 files, one parser call each, all status 255; no script retry
result.hardware_counts: candidate programmer=0, golden programmer=0, terminal=0, JTAG configuration=0
result.board_state: not re-read by T-033; inherited last proven T-031 golden state because T-033 made no hardware call
result.safety: resource lock released; no root prepare, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset/power or process stop
result.next: separate no-hardware remote parser transport validation before another board task
